serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.VeryShock #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Lady Annalie: Hya!{{punch}} After releasing the bowling bowl, Annalie’s ankle buckled and she fell to the ground with a loud thud. #Cashier.Face.normal Lady Annalie: T-The pins… How many did I get… Her voice was hoarse and quiet. The impact must have knocked the wind out of her. Bot: That’s not important right now! Are you alright? #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.angry Melissa: Zero. It went straight to the gutter. Lady Annalie: D-Dammit… Bot: Melissa! That’s not important right now! Melissa: What. She asked. #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.sad Bot: Does anything hurt? Lady Annalie: Besides everything? I don’t think so… Melissa: I never saw a human leg bend this way before, quite remarkable. You: Should we call for an ambulance? Lady Annalie: Anything but that! *cough* I have no money to spare… Lady Annalie: Let me rest a little and I will be fine… Melissa: Alright. {{wi}}Who throws next? After a few minutes, Annalie was more or less back to normal. Somehow her ankle wasn’t even sprained, but just to be sure that she’s alright, she spent the rest of the first game on the bench. #bot.Expression.clear
